Dear Mistral team,

I would like to join you as a Software Engineer, Frontend. I ship TypeScript products end to end, and I have built a frontend for an LLM agent system. That is the kind of interface Vibe puts in front of users, with every step and tool call visible as it runs.

At K-Rose, I was the full-stack engineer (freelance, part-time) on a B2B ordering platform. It is one Next.js 15, React 19 and TypeScript app with a trilingual public site, a client portal and a back office. I built its animated GSAP and Framer Motion UI and tuned it for low-end phones, reaching 92 for performance and 100 for SEO on Lighthouse. During my internship at Talan, I built the Next.js frontend for a LangGraph multi-agent system that turns questions into SQL and charts, with live chart updates over WebSockets.

I would bring the habit of delivering whole features, from the React component to the API, the data model and Sentry monitoring, plus Python from my data engineering work. I am open to relocating to Paris or London.

Best regards,\\
